title: Split and Bridge: Multimodal Generation via Diffusion Bridging
abstract: arXiv:2611.10441v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Visual data are often expressed through multiple complementary modalities (e.g., images and segmentation masks), each capturing different aspects of the same underlying structure. Most existing multimodal methods adopt a top-down paradigm, learning a shared latent variable through joint training from scratch, which limits scalability. We propose Split and Bridge (SnB), a bottom-up framework for multimodal generation that couples pretrained unimodal diffusion models at sampling time. Rather than learning a unified latent space, SnB generates coherent multimodal samples by following a shared diffusion trajectory up to a split point and then branching into modality-specific trajectories guided by a bridge module. This design enables plug-and-play reuse of powerful pretrained models without joint training, making it scalable and easily adaptable. translated_title: 分裂与桥接：通过扩散桥接实现多模态生成
translated_abstract: 视觉数据通常通过多种互补的模态来表达（例如图像和分割掩码），每种模态捕捉同一底层结构的不同方面。现有的大多数多模态方法采用自上而下的范式，通过从头开始的联合训练来学习一个共享的潜在变量，这限制了可扩展性。我们提出了 Split and Bridge（SnB），这是一种自下而上的多模态生成框架，它在采样阶段将预训练的单模态扩散模型耦合起来。SnB 并不学习统一的潜在空间，而是沿着一条共享的扩散轨迹前进到某个分裂点，然后在桥接模块的引导下分支为各模态特定的轨迹，从而生成连贯的多模态样本。这种设计使得强大的预训练模型可以即插即用地被复用，无需联合训练，使其具有良好的可扩展性和易适配性。在标准基准（PolyMNIST、CelebAMask-HQ）以及更复杂的场景（PIE-B……（摘要被截断）
tldr: 提出了一种自下而上的多模态生成框架 SnB，通过在采样时利用桥接模块连接预训练的单模态扩散模型，无需联合训练即可生成连贯的多模态样本，实现了预训练模型的即插即用复用。
